## About the provider
Cryptonic Area is a global technology community for cyber security capability building, tactical training and hands-on systems learning. Slogan: "Empowering the digital defenders." Stated by Cryptonic Area: 5,000+ community members and 1K+ interns trained. Other offerings: SOC Analyst Program (defensive security) and Arena (simulated cyber investigation cases).

## In one paragraph
The WAPT Elite Training Program is a practical, mentor-led online course that takes a complete beginner to real web application penetration testing skills: reconnaissance, manual vulnerability hunting, OWASP Top 10 attacks (IDOR, XSS, SSRF, authentication bypass, business logic flaws), exploit chaining, bug bounty methodology and professional vulnerability reporting (PoC, impact, CVSS, remediation). It is about 100% hands-on, uses industry-standard tools, and includes a completion certificate and an internship opportunity for top performers.

## Program structure
- Weeks 1 to 2, Foundations and Recon: web security fundamentals, lab setup, reconnaissance and asset discovery.
- Weeks 3 to 4, Vulnerability Discovery and Exploitation: manual hunting, OWASP-based attacks (IDOR, XSS, SSRF), advanced exploitation chains.
- Week 5, Infrastructure and Bug Bounty Methodology: network and web infrastructure security, bug bounty workflow, target selection.
- Week 6, Reporting and Career Prep: professional vulnerability reporting, AI-assisted workflows, portfolio building, interview preparation.

## Full curriculum (13 modules)
1. Introduction to web application security: modern web application security architecture; real-world attack vectors; ethical hacking standards, scope handling and legal boundaries.
2. Professional pentesting environment setup: building a real-world pentesting lab; advanced tool configuration; the pentester workflow from recon to reporting.
3. Information gathering and reconnaissance: asset discovery and attack surface mapping; subdomain enumeration, endpoint discovery, hidden assets; bug-bounty-level recon methodology.
4. Vulnerability discovery techniques: manual vulnerability hunting; finding complex flaws beyond automated tools; vulnerability patterns and exploitation logic.
5. Web application attack techniques: IDOR, XSS, SSRF and other critical vulnerabilities; the exploitation approach used in real engagements; hands-on testing in a controlled lab.
6. Advanced web security concepts: attack chains and multi-step exploitation; authentication bypass, access control flaws and business logic vulnerabilities; real-world incident case studies.
7. Network and web infrastructure security: web infrastructure and server-side architecture; exposed services and misconfigurations; practical network reconnaissance.
8. Bug bounty methodology: professional bug bounty workflow; target selection, recon strategy, vulnerability chaining; responsible disclosure standards.
9. Vulnerability reporting: industry-level reports; structuring PoC, impact analysis and remediation; CVSS scoring and severity classification.
10. Security testing tools: professional tools used in real pentesting; automation for large-scale recon and scanning; hands-on usage.
11. AI in cybersecurity: using AI for vulnerability research and automation; AI to speed up recon and analysis; trends in AI-driven security testing.
12. Professional presence in cybersecurity: building a personal brand; sharing research; positioning in the industry.
13. Career path in WAPT: career opportunities; building a portfolio and proof of skills; interview preparation.

## Tools covered
Nmap, Metasploit Framework, Nikto, OWASP ZAP, SQLMap, Wireshark, Burp Suite, and AI tools.

## Skills learners should come away with
Full recon and attack surface mapping; manual vulnerability hunting; exploiting OWASP Top 10 flaws; chaining multi-step exploits; bug bounty target selection and responsible disclosure; writing professional reports (PoC, impact, CVSS, remediation).

## Who it is for
Students and cyber security beginners; aspiring ethical hackers and bug bounty enthusiasts; developers who want to understand how their apps get attacked; career switchers. Reviewers on the page include learners from India, UAE, UK and Nepal.

## Possible directions after the course (indicative, not guaranteed)
Web application penetration tester (entry level), bug bounty hunter, freelance security consultant.

## Bonuses included with enrollment (stated values)
Private mentor WhatsApp group (INR 1,999); vulnerable lab environments (INR 2,499); bug bounty starter toolkit with recon checklists, payload cheat sheets and report templates (INR 1,499); resume and LinkedIn review (INR 999); mock interview session (INR 1,999); lifetime recorded access (INR 1,999).

## How it compares (stated by Cryptonic Area)
Alternatives: free YouTube content (free, unstructured) and costly bootcamps (INR 25,000 to 80,000+). WAPT Elite is INR 4,999 and adds a structured roadmap, live mentor doubt support, vulnerable labs, report-writing practice, a verifiable certificate and Hinglish teaching.

## How to enroll
1. Open https://cryptonicarea.in/wapt and choose "Enroll Now".
2. Pay INR 4,999 through any UPI app (QR code or UPI ID shown at checkout).
3. Submit name, mobile number, email and the UPI transaction / reference ID, then "Confirm My Enrollment".
4. The team verifies the payment and contacts the student. Requests without a valid payment are rejected.
International students or anyone preferring another payment method are assisted on WhatsApp: https://wa.me/918503979765, traning@cryptonicarea.site

## Refund policy
All sales are final. Once enrollment is confirmed and access is granted, no refunds are issued, because seats are capped at 45 per live batch, course materials and labs are delivered immediately, and lab infrastructure is provisioned per student. Exception: a duplicate payment caused by a technical error; write to training@cryptonicarea.site within 48 hours of the transaction.

## Frequently asked questions
**What is the WAPT Live Training Program?** A practical web application penetration testing program focused on real-world security testing: how modern websites are tested for vulnerabilities and how ethical hackers analyse and secure web applications with professional tools.
**Who should join?** Students, beginners, aspiring ethical hackers, developers, bug bounty enthusiasts and anyone curious about real-world web security.
**Are there prerequisites?** Basic computer knowledge and curiosity. No advanced coding or security background is needed.
**What is the format?** Structured recorded classes plus live mentor-led sessions with practical demonstrations in real testing environments.
**What language is used?** A simple Hindi-English mix (Hinglish).
**Will I get a certificate?** Yes, after completing the training and clearing the final online assessment.
**What if I miss a session?** Recordings remain accessible and live doubt-clearing sessions run regularly.
**Is there a job guarantee?** No direct job guarantee. The skills can help you start freelancing, pursue bug bounty work or apply for entry-level offensive security roles.
